nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs. training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. The block is auto-written/re-added by `next dev` (see node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js), so committing it alongside real work keeps the tree clean instead of leaving a perpetual uncommitted diff.
